FROM A CHAMPION’S JOURNEY

A better beginning
for the next generation.

After becoming World Junior Chess Champion in 2007, Ahmed Adly wanted young players to have the structured coaching and training environment he had struggled to find.

That ambition became Adly Chess Academy: a place where children can learn with dedicated coaches, follow a clear curriculum, and experience competition in a supportive community.

Today, that purpose reaches beyond the result of a game. The academy encourages thoughtful decisions, responsibility and respect alongside a lasting love of chess.

OUR MISSION

Develop the player.
Encourage the thinker.

Use chess to nurture critical thinking, good sportsmanship and the confidence to take on new challenges.

OUR VISION

Champions on the board.
Positive people beyond it.

Build a community of capable players who bring integrity and purpose to everything they do.

WHAT WE STAND FOR

Values in every move.

  • 01Cooperation
